The '''"Quick Ship" Shuttle''' was produced by [[Heckson Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] Sector Commander [[Beckar]] had a shuttle stored for use in emergency.
